import importlib.util, time, random
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("m", "/app/submission/main.py")
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)
rnd = random.Random(0)
# simulate worst-case query phase: 87440 clauses spread over 87440 classes, D=1024
natoms = 20
D = 1024
dbits = (1 << D) - 1
lit_dm = [rnd.getrandbits(D) for _ in range(2 * natoms)]
# make clause masks plausible: OR of up to 4 literals
classes = {}
t0 = time.time()
for i in range(87440):
    w = rnd.randint(1, 4)
    lits = tuple(sorted(rnd.sample(range(2 * natoms), w)))
    cm = 0
    for l in lits:
        cm |= lit_dm[l]
    classes.setdefault(cm, []).append(lits)
print("distinct clause masks", len(classes), "build %.2fs" % (time.time() - t0))
t0 = time.time()
pair_map = {}
for members in classes.values():
    tmask = 0; amask = dbits
    for lits in members:
        cm = 0
        for l in lits: cm |= lit_dm[l]
        tmask |= cm; amask &= cm
    pair_map[(tmask, amask)] = pair_map.get((tmask, amask), 0) + 1
print("pair_map", len(pair_map), "%.2fs" % (time.time() - t0))
t0 = time.time()
items_t = [(t, w) for (t, _a), w in pair_map.items()]
items_a = [(a, w) for (_t, a), w in pair_map.items()]
cnt_t = m.column_counts(items_t, D)
cnt_a = m.column_counts(items_a, D)
print("column_counts %.2fs" % (time.time() - t0))
t0 = time.time()
n = len(items_t)
out = []
for d in range(D):
    must = n - cnt_t[d]; may = n - cnt_a[d]
    out.append('v' if must > 0 else ('a' if may > 0 else 'c'))
print("final loop %.2fs" % (time.time() - t0))
import collections; print(collections.Counter(out))
EOF
